verdict.summary: The change correctly preserves all claimants long enough to detect ambiguous bd-id ownership, excludes ambiguous ids from both resume maps, and fails closed before label creation or issue creation when an ambiguous id is in the actual limited plan. The authenticated-owner shadow rule remains consistent with the existing provenance policy. The added self-tests cover trusted duplicates, marker-only duplicates, mixed claimants, the canonical labelled-owner case, and the real apply path; `python3 scripts/bd-to-issues.py --self-test` passes.
